{{Top|leg}}
'''Geoscanners'''<ref name="Scanners">{{JournalCite|4|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide: Scanners}}</ref> or '''geological scanners'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> were used by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]]. They were used to detect geological characteristics including [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits. Geoscanners were also capable of analyzing geothermal, seismic, volcanic, and glacial activity. The [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[7000 Geoscanner]] was a type of geoscanner.<ref name="Scanners" />
